_comment: Phase D: J=18 run at the REAL design structure. PROVISIONAL until E3.
Serves TWO purposes deliberately, so the expensive fit is paid for once:
1. The num_problems confirmation E3 needs. Regime (a) bracketed the
coverage recovery between 30 and 60 menus/cell, but at J=6 with P=2.
2. Step 1 of regime (f): the SAMPLING SE of gamma_model_hat, which the
RQ4 ordering-agreement Monte Carlo needs and cannot get without real
factors [6,3] gives J=18 and P=7, which is structurally IDENTICAL to the
study's real design matrix (5 model dummies + 2 prompt dummies) -- verified
against config.design_matrix_for_pool(). The regime (a) configs used [3,2]
=> J=6, P=2, which has no model dummies at all and so cannot support RQ4.
M_total = menus_per_cell x J x num_presentations, so this is 5x the largest
regime (a) cell at menus_per_cell=100. Cost accordingly; measure before
